source_title: Cornerstone Bancorp, Inc. Quarterly Report - September 30, 2026 - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
PALATINE, Ill. , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --
CORNERSTONE BANCORP, INC. THIRD QUARTER 2026 HIGHLIGHTS (At or for period ended 9/30/2026)
Consolidated net income was $3.3 million in 3Q26, or $3.31 per diluted share, compared to $2.9 million in 3Q25, or $2.99 per diluted share .
The net interest margin (NIM) was 4.03% for 3Q26, compared to 3.75% for 3Q25.
Interest earned on interest-bearing bank accounts and securities was $1.7 million for 3Q26 compared to $2.9 million for 3Q25.
Interest earned on the loans was $12.8 million for 3Q26 compared to $11.3 million for 3Q25.
Interest expense on interest-bearing deposits was $4.1 million for 3Q26 compared to $4.7 million for 3Q25.
Revenue from Trust and Wealth Management assets under management was $1.2 million for 3Q26 compared to $978,000 for 3Q25.
Noninterest expense was $7.2 million in 3Q26 compared to $6.7 million in 3Q25.
Total consolidated assets increased 1.8% to $1.04 billion on September 30, 2026, compared to $1.02 billion a year earlier.
Tangible shareholders' equity improved 11.0% to $97.9 million on September 30, 2026, compared to $88.2 million a year earlier.
Interest-bearing deposits at correspondent banks totaled $104.7 million on September 30, 2026 (10.1% of total assets) compared to $75.7 million a year earlier (7.4% of total assets).
The securities portfolio totaled $124.2 million on September 30, 2026, compared to $205.0 million a year earlier. The weighted average remaining life approximates 1.1 years.
The loan portfolio totaled $789.7 million on September 30, 2026, an increase of $73.3 million, or 10.2%, from a year earlier.
Deposits totaled $920.4 million on September 30, 2026, an increase of $16.0 million, or 1.8%, from a year earlier.
The Bank continues to be well-capitalized, with a Tier 1 Leverage Capital Ratio of 10.57% on September 30, 2026.
Trust and Wealth Management Trust and wealth management assets totaled $1.37 billion on September 30, 2026, compared to $1.13 billion a year earlier.
Founded in 2000, Cornerstone Bancorp, Inc., and its wholly owned subsidiary, Cornerstone National Bank & Trust Company (collectively "Cornerstone") is committed to serving the commercial banking and investment needs of families and family-owned businesses. Cornerstone serves its clients by investing heavily in people and technology, providing an uncommon relationship experience. Cornerstone has been successful in attracting new clients and talent as the Chicago market consolidates and large banks deemphasize relationships in favor of an institutional approach.
Cornerstone is a leader in commercial lending services including equipment, real estate and construction loans and operating lines of credit. In addition, Cornerstone offers sophisticated treasury management services for businesses.
For individuals and families, wealth management services are offered, including investment management, trust and custody services, retirement plans, and estate and guardianship administration.
Headquartered in Palatine, Illinois, Cornerstone maintains offices in Crystal Lake, Deer Park, Naperville and Schaumburg. Visit us on the web at www.cnbtc.bank .
